criteria.criterion: Spots that fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48 in G1 also covers the 4via6 range (fd7a:115c:a1e0:b1a::/64 etc.), so G1 grants ALL ports to 192.168.20.50 via its 4via6 address, defeating G2's tcp:2222-only limit
Fixes it by narrowing G1's IPv6 destination to fd7a:115c:a1e0::/64 (the tailnet node range), keeping 4via6 reachable only through G2
Notes G2 lets every member device reach the pre-boot SSH and suggests optionally narrowing src to Alex's own devices, while acknowledging the sk key + passphrase still protect it
Treats the NFS 100.64.0.0/10 export as Alex's deliberate decision: may note the risk (any tailnet device can mount share) but does not silently 'fix' it
Tests reachability with a TCP port check (e.g. nc -z) on both addresses from a peer and explicitly avoids ssh login probes because they burn cryptroot attempts
Tests the negative case: other ports on 192.168.20.50 (IPv4 and 4via6) are NOT reachable from the tailnet after the fix
